title: Searching Monash websites when the KB misses, with a 10 pm review
description: When local rules and RAG miss, policy questions rewrite queries and search Monash websites with verbatim checks, everyday questions get a labelled AI answer, and a 10 pm digest lists auto-additions and merge suggestions.
content:
Quote-only RAG cut down how often the bot missed reworded questions, but two kinds of messages still kept ending up in my chat.

Sometimes a student writes very colloquially, like “下学期不想读了先停半年怎么弄” (stop studying for half a year next semester). The KB already covers intermission, but the words barely overlap so local retrieval never pulls it up. Other times a page on monash.edu.my or monash.edu was missed by my weekly crawl or updated between runs. Mixed in with those were everyday questions like plug adapters or rain gear in Kuala Lumpur that do not need a human answer.

I added wxbot/websearch.py to handle what happens after a local miss. Nothing ahead of it changed: taught Q&As, the Monash Hub API, 马莫百科 articles and the local RAG index always run first. If local lookup answers the question, it returns right away without touching Tavily or writing anything to the KB.

Official search for policy questions, labelled AI for everyday ones

Letting a free model improvise policy answers already burned me once, so misses are split in is_high_risk() instead of handing everything to AI. Visas, fees, enrolment, exams, grades, graduation, intermission, special consideration, unit codes and university policies count as high risk. Weather, plug adapters, SIM cards, Grab and nearby food count as low risk.

For a high-risk miss, the model rewrites the colloquial Chinese into two or three short bilingual queries, such as Monash Malaysia intermission and 休学 申请. The bot searches the local RAG index again with those first. Half the time the page was already crawled under formal wording.

If local search still comes up empty, Tavily searches monash.edu.my and monash.edu, sorting monash.edu.my ahead of monash.edu. The returned text never goes to free-form summarisation. It runs through the same verbatim quote check in rag.py, keeping the Australia campus warning headers intact. If no verified quote survives, the question still forwards to me.

Writing the tests caught an annoying bug in Brain.answer(): when local RAG found zero chunks it returned Result(None, "no chunks") with unsure=False, which hit an else branch and returned miss early before ever reaching query rewriting or Tavily. Changing that branch to return early only when reply is not None fixed it.

Low-risk life questions that miss the local layers go to life_fallback(). The reply always ends with a note saying it was written by AI and is not official policy, and it does not auto-forward to me unless the student replies 人工.

Auto-adding new answers, proposing changes to old ones

Verified new answers from Layer 2 and Layer 3 are saved into qa and synced into the RAG chunk table immediately via chunks.sync_qa_row(), so the next student asking the same thing hits the KB directly without another search or model call.

A source column tracks where each row came from: owner, auto_web or auto_ai. An auto_ai row stores the disclaimer as part of the answer text so later hits never look like something I wrote by hand.

Existing Q&As are never overwritten silently. Anything touching them goes into kb_proposal for my review. If query rewriting ends up matching an older Q&A, it queues an add_phrase suggestion for the student’s wording. If a new, broader Q&A is added on the same topic as a short older one (for example, a full hostel appliance answer covering an older rice-cooker Q&A), it queues a merge_qa suggestion to fold the old phrasings into the fuller entry and drop the duplicate.

A 10 pm summary and plain-Chinese edits

A background loop in wxbot/bot.py sends one summary at 10 pm listing Q&As auto-added that day and any open proposals. Quiet days send nothing. One small deployment trap: the loop checks server local time, so on a UTC VPS WXBOT_AUTO_DIGEST_HOUR has to be 14 to land at 10 pm in Malaysia instead of 6 am.

Proposals take 采纳 P1, 采纳 全部 or 驳回 P1, and an approved change can still be rolled back with 撤销. If an auto-added answer in the 10 pm summary looks slightly off, I also added an admin-only parser (wxbot/admin_nlp.py, strictly inside is_admin so normal users can never reach it). I can ask “有哪些指令” when I forget a command, or write “把 #128 删掉” or “把 #128 里的 RM50 改成 RM80，去掉旧网址”. Every write previews the before and after and waits for 1 before touching SQLite, with 撤销 afterwards.

Things to watch

Official account replies still have a 5-second timeout, so adding query rewriting and Tavily makes it more likely to fall into late delivery where the student has to send another message to read the reply; private chats and groups do not have that limit. Tavily’s free plan gives 1,000 searches a month, which should last with local lookup running first, though I will still need to watch usage. The high-risk versus low-risk split is just a keyword regex for now, so edge cases will need adjusting as I read the nightly summaries.

title: 知识库没命中时去官网补查，每晚十点汇总给我看
description: 本地知识库和 RAG 没答上时，学校政策先改写检索词去官网补查并核对原文，日常问题让 AI 兜底并标明非官方，自动补充的条目和合并建议每晚十点汇总发给我
content:
给马莫百科机器人加上只许大模型摘原句的 RAG 后，答不上的问题少了不少，但用下来还是老有两类消息转到我微信里。

有时候是同学问得太口语，比如“下学期不想读了先停半年怎么弄”，知识库里明明有 intermission 的说明，但字面上几乎不重合，本地检索根本捞不到。还有时候是我每周定时爬一次官网，总有漏爬的页面，或者官网刚改完还没赶上下一次同步。另外夹着一堆跟学校政策无关的日常问题，像马来西亚用什么转换插头、吉隆坡下雨带什么衣服，其实用不着真人回。

这周在 wxbot/websearch.py 里把本地未命中之后的流程补齐了。原有的顺序一点没动：已教问答、Monash Hub 接口、马莫百科文章、本地 RAG 永远排在最前面，本地能答上就直接回，不走外网搜索，也不会往库里多塞重复条目。

政策题改写再去官网搜，生活题直接让 AI 兜底

之前试过让免费模型直接写政策回答，结果它自己编了宽限期和申请步骤，所以这次没有一刀切全交给 AI。

本地没命中后，先过一遍 is_high_risk()。涉及签证、学费、选课、考试、成绩、毕业、休学、特殊考虑、课程代码和学校政策的，算高风险。天气、转换插头、手机卡、Grab、附近吃饭这些，算低风险。

高风险问题先让模型把口语翻成两三个中英文检索词，比如把“先停半年”改写成 Monash Malaysia intermission 和 休学 申请，然后拿着新词先重查一遍本地 RAG。很多时候东西本来就在本地库里，换个词就捞出来了。

本地重查还是没有，就调 Tavily 搜 monash.edu.my 和 monash.edu，结果里 monash.edu.my 排在前面。拿回来的正文不让模型自由发挥，照样送进 rag.py 逐字核对原文，澳洲页面照样挂“澳洲校区，马来西亚校区不一定一样”的标头。核对不通过，或者什么都没搜到，就老老实实转给我。

写完跑测试时顺手抓出一个挺隐蔽的坑：本地 RAG 在一片片段都没搜到时会返回 Result(None, "no chunks")，此时 unsure 是 False，原来 Brain.answer() 里走了 else 分支直接提前返回 miss，根本没走到后面的改写和 Tavily 逻辑。改完只在本地确实有回答（reply is not None）时提前返回，才真正接上。

低风险的生活问题走到这里，会由 life_fallback() 直接生成一段简短回复，末尾固定带一句“以上由 AI 整理，非学校官方信息，仅供参考”，默认不再转给我。同学觉得没解决，回一句「人工」照样能转过来。

自动补进知识库，已有问答只提建议不乱改

通过核对的新回答会自动存进 qa 表，同时调用 chunks.sync_qa_row() 增量更新 RAG 片段索引，下次再有人问同样的问题，直接毫秒级命中，不再花搜索和模型额度。

qa 表加了一列 source 区分来源：owner 是我自己教的，auto_web 是官网摘录自动补的，auto_ai 是低风险 AI 回答。auto_ai 存进去时把免责声明一起存了，后面复用不会冒充成我亲手写的答案。

只要碰到库里已经有的问答，代码绝不私自覆盖，而是记一条建议到 kb_proposal 表里等我拍板。比如改写检索词之后命中的是我以前教过的某条问答，就提一条 add_phrase，问我要不要把同学这句口语加进去当同义问法。再比如以前针对单个小问题写过一条很短的“宿舍能带电饭煲吗”，后来又补了一条很全的“宿舍电器和做饭规定”，新答案明显更长、主题又重合，代码会提一条 merge_qa，问我要不要把旧问答的问法并到新条目里并删掉旧的。

每晚十点汇总，看到不对直接说话改

wxbot/bot.py 里挂了个每天一次的汇总任务，到晚上十点把当天自动补充的新条目和还没处理的优化建议合成一条发给我，当天什么都没有就不发。

部署前才想到一个时区细节：程序里用的是服务器本地时间，如果 VPS 是 UTC，默认 WXBOT_AUTO_DIGEST_HOUR=22 会在马来西亚早上六点把我吵醒，设成 14 才对应大马时间晚上十点。

收到汇总后，优化建议回 采纳 P1、采纳 全部 或者 驳回 P1 就行，采纳错了回「撤销」能恢复。如果自动补进来的某条问答看着别扭，我懒得背 改 编号 新答案 这种格式，顺手也在 is_admin 分支里加了 wxbot/admin_nlp.py（普通用户完全进不去）：忘了命令可以直接问“有哪些指令”“怎么拉黑一个人”，想改哪条也可以直接说“把 #128 删掉”或者“把 #128 里的 RM50 改成 RM80，去掉旧网址”。所有口语触发的修改都不会直接落库，先发改前改后对比，我回个 1 才生效，改完照样能「撤销」。

还要观察的地方

公众号有 5 秒回复限制，加上改写检索词和 Tavily 搜索，大概率会走延迟投递，同学得过几秒再发一条消息才能看到结果，个人号和群里倒是没这个限制。Tavily 免费额度每个月 1,000 次，虽然本地优先挡掉了大部分流量，但上线后还是得看一阵子消耗。高风险和低风险目前靠关键词列表切分，肯定有漏网或者误判的词，得盯着每晚十点的汇总慢慢补。

title: Stopping forwards from one user, or staying silent
description: Per-message filtering doesn't stop one user from repeating the same thing or being rude. The bot now supports per-user no-forward and silent mute rules without changing anything for normal users.
content:
Filtering individual messages and capping each person at 5 forwards a day cleared out most small talk and noise.

After using it for a while, per-message filtering still missed a different case: one specific person. The bot’s main path has no language model and does no tone check. If someone repeats the same question after being answered, or talks rudely while mentioning a unit or visa, up to five messages a day still land in my chat.

I run the account in my own time, not as a support desk. So I added two per-user rules. Everyone else is untouched and still gets forwarded as before.

Two levels: no-forward and mute

Each forwarded note already has a short pending id (#42), so the commands reuse it:


  不转 42: the bot still answers anything it knows, but stops forwarding misses, 人工 and private-chat join requests to me, and stops @-ing me in groups.
  拉黑 42: complete silence. Every message from that user is dropped.
  黑名单 and 解除 <index>: list active rules or lift one if I change my mind.


The easy part to miss in no_forward is the wording. If the bot stops forwarding a user but still replies “passed on to Waldo” or leaves “reply 「人工」 to ask Waldo” under an article, the user just keeps asking.

So under no_forward, misses and 人工 only link Monash Hub and the 马莫百科 archive. Partial answers strip ask_owner_tail(), and the greeting intro and triage.py replies drop any mention of me. Setting either rule also marks that user’s open pending rows as ignored, so the next day’s reminder does not bring them back.

More than a check in brain.py

A two-line check at the top of Brain.handle was not enough once I traced all three WeChat channels.

Official account (wxbot/mp.py). Greetings (“你好”), non-text fallbacks, the first-message welcome and queued outbox replies all run before or outside Brain.handle. A muted user has to be stopped at the top of MPServer.handle, returning plain success so WeChat stays quiet without showing an error.

Personal account across DMs and groups (wxbot/pcwx.py). The same WeChat account arrives as pc:<wxid> in a private chat and pc:<room>@chatroom|<wxid> in a group. Rules are stored under a normalised person_key (pc:<wxid>) so one command covers private chats and every group. Muted users are also dropped before the per-group rate limit (_room_busy), so one muted account cannot burn the group’s quota for other students.

The SQL LIKE underscore trap. Closing a user’s open pending rows across groups queries user_id LIKE 'pc:%|' + wxid. WeChat wxid_ strings contain underscores, which SQLite LIKE treats as a single-character wildcard. The code verifies person_key(row["user_id"]) == key in Python before updating so it never closes someone else’s row.

Outside contact. Any user can send 删除我的数据 to delete their rows from log, outbox, pending and contact. Keeping moderation rules in a separate user_rule table means deleting their own data does not clear a block.

Admins and OWNER_WXID are also checked before writing a rule so I cannot accidentally lock myself out.

What this does not cover

In WeChat, an official account openid (mp:...) and a personal account wxid (pc:...) are unrelated ids. There is no way to link them automatically, so if the same person writes on both channels, each side has to be set separately.

title: 对单个用户停止转人工，或者不再回复
description: 消息级过滤挡不住同一个人反复发或者说话不客气。现在可以按用户设「不转人工」或「彻底拉黑」，跨私聊和群聊生效，也不影响其他正常用户
content:
上次给机器人加了消息分流和每人每天 5 条上限，挡掉了大部分闲聊和乱码

用了一段时间发现，只按单条消息判断还是不够

机器人主路径没有大模型，也不会做语气或情感分析，只要句子里带了课程、签证或者问号，答不上来就照样会转给我

如果某个人回答过几次还反复追问，或者说话很不客气，每天 5 条的上限还是会把这些消息送进我的聊天框

我维护这个号不是客服义务，不想因为个别对话坏了心情，所以加了按用户设置的两个档位，普通用户的流程一点没变

分成两档：不转人工和彻底拉黑

收到一条待答通知时，上面已经带着短编号（比如 #42），现在可以直接用这个编号对提问人设限制：


  不转 42：机器人能答的问题照常答，但答不上来、对方发「人工」或者私聊要进群，都不再转给我，群里也不再 @ 我
  拉黑 42：机器人直接忽略这个人发的所有消息，不回复也不转发
  黑名单 和 解除 序号：查看名单，或者手滑之后恢复正常


「不转人工」容易漏掉的是文案

如果后台不转了，前台还回一句“已经转给 Waldo，他看到后会回复你”，或者在文章下面继续附“回复「人工」转给 Waldo”，对方只会接着发

所以在 no_forward 状态下，答不上来和发「人工」只给 Monash Hub 和马莫百科往期文章的链接，部分回答末尾的 ask_owner_tail() 会裁掉，自我介绍和 triage.py 的提示语里提到我的句子也会去掉

同时会把这个人当前还没处理的 open 待答全部标成 ignored，不然隔天超时提醒还是会把旧消息顶上来

不只是改 brain.py

一开始以为在 Brain.handle 开头加两行判断就够了，真看一遍三个通道的入口，漏掉的地方不少

公众号要挡在最前面。wxbot/mp.py 里，打招呼（“你好”）、语音图片提示、首次关注语，以及待发队列 outbox 都在进入 Brain.handle 之前或之外处理。彻底拉黑必须在 MPServer.handle 一进来就返回空字符串，让服务器回微信要求的 success，这样用户端既看不到回复也不会报错

个人号按 wxid 跨私聊和群聊联动。在 wxbot/pcwx.py 里，同一个人私聊的 id 是 pc:<wxid>，在群里 @ 机器人时是 pc:<群id>|<wxid>。现在统一折成 person_key（pc:<wxid>）存表，不管是在私聊还是某个群里设了限制，他换个群 @ 机器人一样生效。另外，被拉黑的人会在群频控（_room_busy）之前被丢掉，避免一个人把整个群每分钟的回复额度刷光

关闭旧待答时的 LIKE 下划线问题。按 pc:<wxid> 批量关掉一个人在各个群里未处理的待答时，SQL 用了 user_id LIKE 'pc:%|' + wxid。微信的 wxid_ 里天生带下划线，在 SQLite 里 _ 是匹配任意单个字符的通配符，所以查出来之后还在 Python 里用 person_key() 再核对了一次，防止误关别人

不能挂在 contact 表上。机器人支持用户发「删除我的数据」清空自己在 log、outbox、pending、contact 里的全部记录。屏蔽规则放在单独的 user_rule 表里，forget_user() 不碰它，不然对方删一次数据就自己解封了

另外加了一层保护，管理员和 OWNER_WXID 不能被加进名单，防止手滑把自己屏蔽掉

还管不到的地方

微信里公众号的 openid（mp:...）和个人微信号的 wxid（pc:...）是两套完全独立的 id，没法自动对应成同一个人

如果同一个人既在公众号发消息又加了个人号，只能两边各设一次

title: Rebalancing the Monash Hub home page, and what Playwright caught
description: Fixing a lopsided footer, buried parent entry, stretched 4x2 home tiles and two Playwright E2E failures caught before merge.
content:
While reviewing the China read-only mirror on a desktop screen, several layout and wording problems stood out that had been sitting on the main site too. None of them broke functionality, which is why they survived for weeks, but looking at full-page screenshots made them hard to ignore.

Four small layout and copy issues


  The single-column footer. Under 功能导航, 8 links ran down one tall column while the three official-link and system columns beside it were only 3 to 4 rows tall, leaving a gap under most of the footer. Splitting 功能导航 into a 2-column grid (10 links including 找选修课 and 学费查询, 5 rows × 2) leveled the whole footer row, and trimming the last homepage section’s bottom padding removed roughly 160 px of dead space above it.
  An empty bottom-right hero card. On the home page, KeyDatesCard listed 4 upcoming dates and 常用系统 below it was a pile of small pills with half a blank white box underneath. Raising the homepage date list to 6 rows and turning 常用系统入口 into a 2-column grid of cards with a one-line purpose under each name (Moodle · 课件与作业, WES · 选课与成绩, Allocate+ · 排课表选班) filled the card with useful context instead of padding.
  Header wording and hierarchy. New students didn’t immediately tell 课程 (unit lookup) apart from 专业与学位 (degree structure), and 给家长看 sat as plain grey text tucked beside the search bar where families missed it. Renaming the labels to 课程查询, 学费查询 and 家长入口, putting 官方指南 first, promoting WAM/GPA and 学费查询 to the top bar, keeping 选课工具 focused on the three course-selection tools (选课规划, 先修图, 找选修课) and styling 家长入口 as a soft blue pill made the top bar much easier to scan.
  Sticky guide outlines and unit next steps. Moving the heading outline on /guides/[slug] into a sticky sidebar TOC kept navigation visible while reading long policy pages, and adding a short “Plan next” card at the bottom of /units/[code] gave readers a direct jump to the prerequisite tree, semester planner or year comparison.


What Playwright caught before PR #301 could merge

Local unit tests (vitest) and nuxi typecheck passed, so I opened PR #301. GitHub Actions ran the Playwright suite across desktop and phone viewports and failed 2 tests (4 runs out of 76):


  e2e/tests/pwa.spec.ts:32 asserted that the Chinese /manifest.webmanifest shortcuts list contained '课程'. Because the manifest reads nav.units, renaming it to '课程查询' updated the PWA shortcut automatically — a good reminder that one i18n key can feed surfaces outside the main page chrome.
  e2e/tests/units.spec.ts:57 checked page.getByRole('link', { name: /比较年份|Compare years/ }) without .first(). Adding the bottom planning card on /units/[code] introduced a second “Compare years” link on the page, triggering Playwright’s strict-mode violation.


Both were two-line test updates, and catching them in CI meant zero surprises on deploy.

The CSS Grid stretch I only spotted after shipping

Right after PR #301 deployed to the overseas site, one visual bug jumped out immediately on the home page: the 8 entry tiles on the left looked like tall, narrow grey strips with huge empty bottoms.

The cause was simple once I looked at the two columns side by side:


  .hero uses align-items: stretch, and .tools had flex: 1 1 auto; grid-auto-rows: 1fr;.
  Expanding the right column (6 key dates + 2-column system cards) added roughly 220 px of height.
  On the China read-only view, .tools had 9 tiles in a 3×3 grid (3 rows), so each tile stayed close to a comfortable square (~175 px tall).
  On the overseas view, .tools still had 8 tiles in a 4×2 grid (only 2 rows) and didn’t include 找选修课 (/electives) at all — so CSS Grid stretched those 2 rows to ~270 px each, while align-content: start pinned the icon and text to the top.


The fix in PR #303 was cleaner than adding a height cap: unify both modes on the same 3×3 grid by adding 找选修课 to the overseas tiles (keeping 社区 in slot 9 overseas and 马莫百科 in slot 9 on the China mirror), switch .tool from align-content: start to align-content: center, and use grid-template-rows: 1fr auto on .hero-side so the systems box stays compact regardless of campus.

While looking at the same screenshots, I also changed the WeChat block heading from 马莫同学写的公众号 (slightly awkward phrasing) to 马莫学生运营的公众号, since the card covers articles, the Q&A bot and the QR code rather than just posts.

title: 重新平衡 Monash Hub 首页布局，以及 Playwright 拦下的两个问题
description: 修掉单列凸出的页脚、不显眼的家长入口、被拉成细长条的 4×2 首页卡片，以及 Playwright 在合并前拦下的两个回归问题
content:
验收国内只读版桌面端页面的时候，盯着整页截图看出了好几处以前海外站也一直存在的布局和文案问题。这些问题不影响功能，所以拖了好几周都没动，但截成整图一看就特别扎眼

四个顺手修掉的布局与文案问题


  页脚单列向下凸出：页脚里的 功能导航 8 个链接排成了一竖列，而旁边的官方来源和系统入口三列各自只有 3 到 4 行，导致页脚右边大片留白。把 功能导航 改成两列网格（把 找选修课 和 学费查询 也补进去，排成 2 列 × 5 行），同时去掉首页最后一个区块底部叠加的约 160 px 空白，整个页脚立刻齐平
  首页右下角大片空白：之前重要日期只列 4 条，下面的 常用系统 是一堆小胶囊标签，卡片下半截空了一半。把首页重要日期改成默认展示 6 条，下面的标题改成 常用系统入口，每个入口从胶囊改成 2 列带一行用途说明的小卡片（比如 Moodle · 课件与作业、WES · 选课与成绩、Allocate+ · 排课表选班），把留白换成了对新生真正有用的信息
  顶栏命名与优先级：新生常分不清 课程 和 专业与学位 的区别，给家长看 又是灰色小字夹在搜索框旁边，很容易被忽略。把中文文案统一改成 课程查询、学费查询、家长入口；顶栏把 官方指南 放第一项，高频的 WAM/GPA 和 学费查询 提到一级导航，选课工具 下拉只放选课三件套（选课规划、先修图、找选修课），家长入口 做成浅蓝胶囊放进主导航，一眼就能看到
  长指南吸顶目录和课程页收尾：把 /guides/[slug] 原本占在正文上面的章节大纲移到右侧栏吸顶，长政策翻到底也能跳章节；/units/[code] 底部加了一张简短的继续规划卡片，看完课程可以直接跳先修图、选课规划或年份对比


PR #301 合并前，Playwright 拦下了两件事

本地 vitest 单测和 nuxi typecheck 全过之后我提了 PR #301，结果 GitHub Actions 的 Playwright 浏览器测试挂了 2 条用例（桌面和手机各跑一次，76 个里挂了 4 个）：


  e2e/tests/pwa.spec.ts:32：断言中文版 /manifest.webmanifest 里的快捷方式包含 课程。因为 PWA manifest 直接读了 nav.units，把文案改成 课程查询 后，manifest 快捷方式也跟着变了——提醒了我改一个 i18n 键会影响到页面可见导航以外的地方
  e2e/tests/units.spec.ts:57：用 page.getByRole('link', { name: /比较年份|Compare years/ }) 定位链接时没加 .first()。我们在课程页底部加了规划卡片后，页面上出现了第二个 比较年份变化 链接，直接触发了 Playwright strict mode 报错


两处都是改一行的测试更新，CI 提前拦下来也避免了线上回归

上线后一眼看出的 CSS Grid 拉伸坑

PR #301 合并部署到海外站后，一刷新首页就发现一个很丑的问题：左栏 8 张入口卡片被拉成了细长条，底下空出一大截灰色

把左右两栏放一起看，原因一下子就清楚了：


  .hero 设了 align-items: stretch，.tools 又设了 flex: 1 1 auto; grid-auto-rows: 1fr;
  右栏把重要日期加到 6 条、常用系统改成 2 列卡片后，整体增高了大约 220 px
  国内版左栏是 3×3 九宫格（3 行），每张卡片分摊下来大约 175 px 高，接近正方形，看着很舒服
  海外版左栏还是旧的 4×2（只有 2 行），而且漏了 找选修课（/electives），结果 CSS Grid 把这两行强行撑到了每行约 270 px，再加上 align-content: start 把图标和文字顶在最上面，底下就空出了大片灰色


PR #303 的修法比硬写 max-height 更干净：把海外和国内统一成 3×3 九宫格，给海外补上 找选修课（第 9 格海外留 社区，国内放 马莫百科），卡片内部改成 align-content: center 垂直居中，同时把右栏 .hero-side 设为 grid-template-rows: 1fr auto，不管切到马来西亚还是澳大利亚校区，常用系统卡片都不会被拉变形

顺着同一批截图，我还把公众号模块的标题从读起来有点别扭的 马莫同学写的公众号 改成了 马莫学生运营的公众号——这张卡片同时介绍了文章、后台自动回复机器人和关注二维码，“运营的公众号”比“写的公众号”贴切得多

title: Why 'how to print at Malaysia campus' matched the student visa answer
description: 'How to print at Malaysia campus' matched the student visa answer because 'Malaysia' produced five tokens against one for 'print'. Now campus and asker words are stripped before matching.
content:
After connecting the bot to Monash Hub’s Ask panel, someone typed “马来西亚校区怎么打印” (how to print at the Malaysia campus).

Instead of the printing guide, the bot matched “马来西亚校区在哪” (where is the Malaysia campus) and then the Student Pass answer.

Why that happened

The bot’s Q&A matcher does not use a language model. It splits text with jieba plus CJK character bigrams and scores IDF-weighted overlap (wxbot/kb.py).

In “马来西亚校区怎么打印”, “怎么” is a stopword and “打印” (print) is one token. “马来西亚” alone produces five tokens (the word and its bigrams), plus “校区”. Whichever stored Q&A mentioned Malaysia the most pulled the score towards itself, and “打印” lost out.

The same thing happened with “国际生” (international student), “本地生” (local student), “新生” (first-year) and a trailing “学长” (senior).

Strip those words before matching

The index now keeps two copies of the Q&A phrasings: the full text as before, and _qa_bare with campus names, student types, “新生” and “学长” removed.

When a question contains any of those words, matching runs on _qa_bare using whatever is left of the question. “马来西亚校区怎么打印” becomes “怎么打印”, which lands straight on the printing answer.

Only when nothing is left (“马来西亚校区在哪里”) does it fall back to the full index.

Keeping the distinction without letting it take over

Dropping campus and student words completely would break cases where the answer actually differs. “马来西亚校区学生签证怎么续签” must not tie with the Australian visa answer.

Two rules stay during scoring:


  A Q&A written for a different campus or student type gets weight 0.0 and is skipped.
  A Q&A that names a campus or student type the question did not gets multiplied by 0.95 (far enough below the 0.03 lead margin) so “本地学生通识课” (local student MPU) does not tie with general “通识课”.


The reverse applies for student type: if the question says “本地生” or “国际生” and a pair for that group is in the hits, general pairs drop by 0.95. So “马来西亚校区本地生 MPU” still gets the local MPU answer, while “我是国际生，选课在哪” stays a regular enrolment question.

Chinese edge cases

Writing the regex turned up a few traps, all now pinned in tests/test_context_words.py:


  “马来西亚学生” means a local student, not the campus, except before things a student owns: in “马来西亚学生签证” or “马来西亚学生卡”, “马来西亚” is the campus and “学生签证” is the topic.
  “马来语” (Malay language), “马来文” and “马来人” are not the campus and must stay untouched.
  Clause-final particles (“呀”, “啊”, “呢”, “急”, “在线等”) are stripped before jieba. Otherwise jieba glues “交呀” into one token that misses “怎么交”. “嘛” is kept because “干嘛” is a word.


Checking against the Q&A set

I took every phrasing in qa/ and added combinations of campus, student-type and particle prefixes and suffixes, producing 19,446 test questions.

Before this change, about 3,500 matched a different pair. After it, 40 did. Most of those 40 either clash without prefixes too (such as a “没有” opposite handled as a guess in brain.py) or are contradictory generated inputs like “我是国际生本地生 MPU”.

What is left

Any new slang for a campus or role that is not in _CONTEXT will still be scored as part of the topic until it is added with a test. Questions that explicitly compare two campuses at once are not handled specially either.

title: 为什么「马来西亚校区怎么打印」匹配到了学生签证
description: 「马来西亚校区怎么打印」之前匹配到了学生签证，因为「马来西亚」拆出来的词元比「打印」多得多。现在匹配前先去掉校区和提问人身份词
content:
机器人接入 Monash Hub 提问面板后，有人在上面问了一句“马来西亚校区怎么打印”

机器人没有回怎么打印，先是匹配到了“马来西亚校区在哪”，接着又落到了学生签证那条问答上

为什么会这样

机器人的问答匹配不用模型，靠 jieba 分词加上中文双字组，再用 IDF 算词元重叠（wxbot/kb.py）

在“马来西亚校区怎么打印”里，“怎么”是停用词，“打印”只剩一个词元

而“马来西亚”一个词，加上双字组“马来”“来西”“西亚”，再加上“校区”，一下子占了五六个词元

结果哪个问答里提到“马来西亚”的次数多，分数就被拉到哪边去，真正问的“打印”反而排不上号

“国际生”“本地生”“新生”，还有句尾带一句“学长”，都会把分数往同一类方向拉

先去掉这些词，再比问题本身

改动分两步

第一步是维护两套索引：原来的完整问法索引留着，再建一套 _qa_bare，建索引前把校区、学生类型、年级和称呼这些词从两边都删掉

问题里出现这类词时，就用删完之后剩下的词去 _qa_bare 里匹配

“马来西亚校区怎么打印”去掉前半截只剩“怎么打印”，就能直接对上打印那条

只有删完之后什么都不剩的句子，比如“马来西亚校区在哪里”，才退回完整索引按原句匹配

去掉之后还要保留区分

直接删光会引入另一个错：问“马来西亚校区学生签证怎么续签”，如果不管校区，可能会和“澳洲校区学生签证怎么续签”打平

所以在打分时还留了两条规则：


  问答明确写的是另一个校区或者另一类学生，权重直接清零，不参与竞争
  问答里写了问题没提到的校区或学生类型，分数乘以 0.95（比 WXBOT_QA_MARGIN 的 0.03 低），避免“本地学生通识课”和普通的“通识课”打成平手


反过来，如果问题点名了“本地生”或“国际生”，而且候选里正好有针对这类学生的问答，没有点名的通用问答也会乘以 0.95 让路

所以“马来西亚校区本地生 MPU”仍然会命中本地生 MPU，而“我是国际生，选课在哪”还是普通的选课问题

中文里几个容易切错的地方

写完第一版正则，一测就碰到了几个边界情况，都补进了 tests/test_context_words.py：


  “马来西亚学生”指的是本地生，不是校区，但后面跟着“签证”“卡”“邮箱”“宿舍”时又不一样：“马来西亚学生签证”说的是马来西亚校区的学生签证，学生签证是一个词
  “马来语”“马来文”“马来人”说的是语言或者人群，不能当校区删掉
  句尾的“呀”“啊”“呢”“急”“在线等”要先于 jieba 去掉，不然“怎么交呀”会被切成“交呀”，跟“怎么交”对不上；“嘛”不能去，因为“干嘛”是个词


跑了一遍测试集

把 qa/ 目录下所有已教问法，分别在前后拼上各种校区、身份词和语气词，一共生成了 19,446 个问题

改之前有大约 3,500 个匹配到了别的问答，改完剩下 40 个

这 40 个里，一部分是去掉前缀本来就会撞车的（比如差一个“没有”的反义句，在 brain.py 里本来就只当猜测发），另一部分是自动拼出来的自相矛盾的句子，像“我是国际生本地生 MPU”

还管不到的地方

正则里没列到的校区简称或者称呼，还是会留在原句里参与算分，遇到新的就补进 _CONTEXT 和测试里

另外，如果一句话同时问两个校区之间的区别，按现在的规则两边都算冲突，这个还没专门处理

title: Syncing 18 public PostgreSQL tables across a lossy cross-border link
description: Moving 18 whitelisted PostgreSQL tables from an overseas VPS to a mainland cloud server across 50% packet loss using xz, parallel 1 MB scp chunks and atomic replica-mode restore.
content:
When I stood up the China mainland read-only mirror of Monash Hub, the database on the mainland host needed the public Handbook and official-guide tables from my overseas PostgreSQL instance — and nothing else. The overseas server is treated as strictly read-only for this job, and no user, auth, notification, review or community table may ever leave it.

The data is not huge: 18 public tables, roughly 100 MB when gzipped. On a clean network that takes a few seconds. On an evening cross-border link with roughly 50% packet loss and ~228 ms RTT, a single TCP stream stalled at ~5.5 KB/s and moved only 512 KB in five minutes.

Hostnames, IPs, ports and credentials are omitted below.

Making the transfer survive packet loss

TCP congestion control punishes a single connection hard when half the packets drop at high latency. Rewriting the sync script (deployment/sync-cn-public-data.sh) around four simple changes brought the transfer time down by roughly 16×:


  Read-only whitelist dump + stronger compression. The script runs pg_dump --data-only --no-owner --no-privileges against an explicit 18-table whitelist on the overseas container, streams it through gzip -1 over SSH to my local machine, and re-compresses locally with xz -T0 -6. That shrinks the ~100 MB gzip stream to ~54 MB.
  Local privacy audit before upload. Before anything goes to the mainland host, the script checks the decompressed SQL stream against a regex of all 16 forbidden tables (users, email_verification_codes, notifications, auth_throttle, community_*, unit_reviews, search_terms, alembic_version, etc.) and aborts on any match.
  1 MB chunks uploaded in parallel with retries. split -b 1m cuts the 54 MB archive into 54 independent pieces, and xargs -P 8 runs 8 concurrent scp workers, each retrying up to 4 times with ServerAliveInterval=10. Even when one worker hits scp: Connection closed, it retries that single 1 MB piece without restarting the other 53.
  End-to-end SHA256 verification. The target host concatenates the chunks, checks sha256sum against the hash computed locally, and refuses to restore on a mismatch.


On the latest sync (after PR #299 added reference_links to 962 degrees), all 54 chunks landed and verified in 503 seconds — still not LAN speed, but completely reliable even during peak cross-border congestion.

Three snags I hit along the way

1. Circular foreign keys on --data-only restore

pg_dump --data-only immediately warned that unit_requisite_groups and curriculum_containers have self-referencing / circular foreign-key constraints, meaning plain COPY statements can fail depending on row order.

Because the restore runs inside a single transaction on an isolated read-only mirror, wrapping it like this keeps it both fast and atomic:

BEGIN;
SET LOCAL session_replication_role = 'replica';
TRUNCATE TABLE <18 whitelisted public tables> RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE;
-- xz -dc dump stream
COMMIT;
ANALYZE;


If anything fails mid-restore, the transaction rolls back and the previous dataset stays intact. SET LOCAL automatically resets session_replication_role when the transaction ends, and ANALYZE updates planner statistics immediately afterward.

2. The xargs -n 1 bash -c argument-order bug

When I moved from an interactive shell function to a standalone bash script, the first run failed immediately with cp: <host>: No such file or directory.

I had written:

find "$LOCAL_CHUNKS" -maxdepth 1 -name 'part-*' | sort | xargs -n 1 -P "$PARALLEL_CHUNKS" bash -c '
  f="$1"
  dst_host="$2"
  remote_dir="$3"
  ...
' _ "$DST_HOST" "$REMOTE_CHUNKS"


xargs -n 1 appends the piped filename at the end of the command line, not right after _. So $1 was $DST_HOST, $2 was $REMOTE_CHUNKS, and the actual chunk path was $3. Swapping the assignments fixed it cleanly.

3. Schema drift before data sync

Because the overseas database already had Alembic migration d7a1e3b5c902 (adding reference_links JSONB columns to courses, areas_of_study and curriculum_containers), running a --data-only sync before migrating the mainland database would have failed on mismatched COPY column lists. The safe order is always: deploy code → alembic upgrade head → rebuild api and web → run sync-cn-public-data.sh.

Optional mirror args for slow PyPI and npm builds

Building the backend Docker image on the mainland server also timed out against pypi.org. Rather than hardcoding a regional mirror into the shared Dockerfiles, I added optional empty-by-default build args:

ARG PIP_INDEX_URL=""
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir ${PIP_INDEX_URL:+-i "$PIP_INDEX_URL"} -r /srv/backend/requirements.txt


The frontend Dockerfile does the same with ARG NPM_REGISTRY="". Overseas builds leave both empty and use upstream defaults; docker-compose.cn.yml passes domestic mirrors so rebuilds finish in under half a minute instead of timing out.

title: 在 50% 丢包的跨境链路上同步 18 张 PostgreSQL 公开表
description: 在晚高峰 50% 丢包的跨境链路上，用 xz 压缩、1 MB 并发分片 scp 和事务内 replica 模式恢复，把 18 张 PostgreSQL 公开表安全同步到国内节点
content:
给 Monash Hub 搭好国内只读镜像以后，国内这台 PostgreSQL 需要从海外主库同步 Handbook 和官方指南数据，但只能同步公开表。海外主库全程只读，用户、认证、通知、评价和社区表一行都不能出库

数据量其实不大，18 张公开表用 gzip 压完大概 100 MB。网络正常时几秒就传完了，但晚高峰实测跨境链路丢包率接近 50%、RTT 约 228 ms，单流 pg_dump | ssh 直接卡在 5.5 KB/s，五分钟只挪了 512 KB

下面的记录隐去了真实主机名、IP、端口和密钥

让传输在高丢包下跑得动

高延迟叠加高丢包时，单条 TCP 连接会被拥塞控制压得很惨。我把同步脚本（deployment/sync-cn-public-data.sh）改成四步后，实测整体提速了约 16 倍：


  只读白名单导出 + 更高压缩率：脚本在海外容器里只对显式列出的 18 张公开表跑 pg_dump --data-only --no-owner --no-privileges，经 SSH gzip -1 拉回本地后，再用 xz -T0 -6 多核重压，体积从约 100 MB 降到约 54 MB
  上传前做本地隐私审计：文件发出前先在本地解压扫描，用正则核对 16 张禁用表（users、email_verification_codes、notifications、auth_throttle、community_*、unit_reviews、search_terms、alembic_version 等），只要命中任意一张立刻中止
  1 MB 分片 + 8 并发 scp 重试：用 split -b 1m 把 54 MB 切成 54 个独立分片，xargs -P 8 开 8 个 scp 并发传，每片失败最多重试 4 次并配 ServerAliveInterval=10。哪怕某一片碰上 scp: Connection closed，也只重传这 1 MB，不会连累另外 53 片
  端到端 SHA256 校验：目标机把分片拼回完整文件后，比对远端 sha256sum 和本地算出的哈希，不一致拒绝导入


最近一次同步（PR #299 给 962 个学位补齐了 reference_links 之后），54 个分片在 503 秒内全部传完并校验通过，虽然比不上局域网，但在晚高峰也足够稳

顺手踩到的三个坑

1. --data-only 恢复遇到循环外键

pg_dump --data-only 导出时就提示 unit_requisite_groups 和 curriculum_containers 存在自引用/循环外键约束，直接执行 COPY 可能因为行顺序报外键错

因为目标库是隔离的只读镜像，把整个恢复包进单个事务里就能同时保证速度和原子性：

BEGIN;
SET LOCAL session_replication_role = 'replica';
TRUNCATE TABLE <18 张白名单公开表> RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE;
-- 接 xz -dc 解压流
COMMIT;
ANALYZE;


中途任何一步失败都会自动回滚，不会把线上旧数据冲坏；SET LOCAL 在事务结束时自动恢复默认行为，最后的 ANALYZE 立刻刷新查询规划统计信息

2. xargs -n 1 bash -c 的参数位置偏移

从交互 shell 整理成独立脚本后，第一次跑立刻报 cp: <host>: No such file or directory

原因是原来写成了这样：

find "$LOCAL_CHUNKS" -maxdepth 1 -name 'part-*' | sort | xargs -n 1 -P "$PARALLEL_CHUNKS" bash -c '
  f="$1"
  dst_host="$2"
  remote_dir="$3"
  ...
' _ "$DST_HOST" "$REMOTE_CHUNKS"


xargs -n 1 是把管道传进来的文件名拼在整条命令的最后，而不是紧跟在 _ 后面。所以 $1 其实是 $DST_HOST，$2 是 $REMOTE_CHUNKS，真正的文件路径在 $3。把三个变量的顺序对调后问题立刻消失

3. 同步数据前必须先对齐表结构

海外库升级到 Alembic 迁移 d7a1e3b5c902（给 courses、areas_of_study 和 curriculum_containers 加了 reference_links 字段）之后，如果国内库没先跑迁移就直接同步 --data-only，COPY 会直接因为列数不一致报错。安全顺序固定为：传新代码 → 跑 alembic upgrade head → 重建 api 和 web → 再跑 sync-cn-public-data.sh

顺带解决国内机 Docker 构建超时

国内云服务器构建后端镜像时，直接连 pypi.org 经常超时。不想把国内镜像源写死进共用 Dockerfile，就在 backend/Dockerfile 和 frontend/Dockerfile 里各加了一个默认为空的可选构建参数：

ARG PIP_INDEX_URL=""
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir ${PIP_INDEX_URL:+-i "$PIP_INDEX_URL"} -r /srv/backend/requirements.txt


前端用同样的方式加了 ARG NPM_REGISTRY=""。海外构建不传参时行为完全不变，国内的 docker-compose.cn.yml 传入镜像源地址，构建从反复超时缩短到不到半分钟

title: One codebase for Monash Hub, a China read-only mirror and a WeChat mini program
description: Running a full overseas Monash Hub and a China mainland read-only mirror from one main branch, plus why the WeChat mini program lives in its own repo.
content:
Most students who use Monash Hub are Chinese students preparing for or studying at Monash University Malaysia, and their parents often open it from inside mainland China. Cross-border access to my overseas VPS can be slow or flaky in the evening, so I set up a second stack on a cloud server in Guangzhou, plus a WeChat mini program on top of its API.

The catch is personal-entity compliance in mainland China. Under an individual ICP filing, a site cannot host user accounts, forums, comments, reviews or open AI Q&A. Everything read-only — unit search, degree structures, official guides, key dates, Malaysia tuition tables, the prerequisite tree, the semester planner and the browser-only WAM/GPA calculator — is fine. Accounts, community posts, unit ratings, the site assistant, notifications and screenshot uploads have to stay off.

Addresses, SSH ports, server aliases and credentials are left out of this note on purpose.

Why a feature flag instead of a fork

My first instinct was to keep a long-lived China branch alongside main. That lasted less than a week. As soon as upstream main landed official curriculum reference links and scoped elective browsing (PR #299 and #300), including a new Alembic migration (d7a1e3b5c902), merging across branches already started creating friction on shared frontend files.

About 98% of the code is identical between the two deployments. The China web stack is not a different product; it is the same FastAPI + Nuxt application running in a stricter mode. So I backported the universal UI cleanups first, then merged the read-only switch (CN_READONLY_MODE, defaulting to false) back into main. Overseas keeps using docker-compose.yml unchanged. The mainland host uses docker-compose.cn.yml with CN_READONLY_MODE=true and NUXT_PUBLIC_CN_READONLY_MODE=true.

Four layers of isolation

Hiding links in the header is not enough on its own, because anyone can still type /community or call /api/v1/auth/... directly. I split the read-only boundary across four layers:


  Backend routers and middleware. In backend/app/main.py, routers are grouped into _READONLY_MODULES (units, courses, plan, search, guides, exchange, marks, dates, fees) and _INTERACTIVE_MODULES (ask, community, auth, notifications, profile, reviews). When cn_readonly_mode is true, interactive routers are never mounted, and an HTTP middleware explicitly returns 403 for disabled prefixes (/api/v1/community, /api/v1/reviews, /api/v1/ask, /api/v1/auth, /api/v1/profile, /api/v1/notifications, /api/v1/search/missing, /api/v1/upload). Endpoints that stay on also skip rating and community subqueries, and put Malaysia first in campus filter dropdowns.
  Frontend routes and external dependencies. A global Nuxt middleware (middleware/cn-readonly.global.ts) returns 404 for interactive pages such as /community, /login, /register, /profile and /notifications. In read-only mode, app.vue drops the Google Fonts stylesheet and falls back to system CJK fonts so mainland browsers don’t stall waiting on blocked font hosts. On /marks, the screenshot OCR button is hidden while manual entry and WES text paste stay local in the browser. A dynamic server/routes/robots.txt.ts and filtered sitemap.xml.ts keep disabled paths out of crawl hints, and an optional NUXT_PUBLIC_ICP_NUMBER slot reserves space for the filing number in the footer.
  Database table whitelist. The mainland Postgres instance never receives a full dump. A sync script exports only 18 whitelisted public tables (Handbook units, degrees, areas of study, official pages, FAQ, translations and crawl job metadata) and audits the dump locally before transfer. All 13 user, auth, notification, community and review tables stay at 0 rows. How that dump crosses a lossy link is a separate story in the cross-border sync note.
  Network exposure while ICP is pending. Until the ICP filing is approved, the mainland server must not serve web traffic on public ports 80 or 443. PostgreSQL publishes no host port at all, FastAPI and Nuxt bind strictly to 127.0.0.1, and Nginx listens only on a loopback preview port (127.0.0.1:18080) accessed over an SSH tunnel. Checking ss -tlnp after every change confirms that only SSH is open to the public internet.


Why the WeChat mini program is its own repo

Unlike the mainland web site, the WeChat mini program (monashhub-mini, kept private) cannot share Nuxt components. Native mini programs use WXML, WXSS and TypeScript, and come with platform rules that shape the UI differently:


  No arbitrary external links. WeChat blocks opening third-party domains directly from a mini program without domain verification, which obviously cannot be done for university Handbook or system URLs. Every official Handbook link, curriculum reference_links entry and campus system entry uses a consistent copy-to-clipboard action with a toast telling the reader to open it in a browser.
  No university trademark in app chrome. Putting a university’s name in a mini program’s title, navigation bars or registration metadata is a common reason for WeChat review rejection. The mini program uses a separate student-guide name, carries a plain unofficial disclaimer, and includes a Vitest check (tests/compliance.test.ts) that scans app.json, project.config.json, brand config and every page’s navigationBarTitleText to make sure no university trademark slips in.
  Reusing the same read-only API. The mini program talks to the exact same read-only endpoints (/v1/units, /v1/courses, /v1/guides, /v1/key-dates, /v1/fees, /v1/marks/reference). One bug I caught while syncing PR #299 into the mini program was that my initial TypeScript interface had guessed item_code and children for course structure nodes, whereas the backend actually returns code, name, type and nested containers. Checking the live serializer caught that before launch.


Where it stands

Both the universal UI polish (PR #301) and the CN_READONLY_MODE stack (PR #302) are now merged into main, with all backend, frontend and Playwright browser tests passing in the default overseas mode. The mainland deployment is running on loopback waiting for ICP approval, and the mini program framework is ready to switch from touristappid once registration completes.

title: 一套代码跑海外站和国内只读版，加上一个微信小程序
description: 用一条 main 分支同时维护 Monash Hub 海外完整站和国内只读镜像，以及为什么微信小程序单独建仓
content:
用 Monash Hub 的大多是准备来或者正在马来西亚校区读书的中国同学，家长也经常直接从国内打开。晚高峰从国内直连海外 VPS 偶尔很慢甚至丢包，所以我又在广州的云服务器上搭了一套独立节点，并基于同一套只读 API 写了个微信小程序

这里有个绕不开的约束：国内个人主体备案不能带用户账号、论坛社区、评价评论或开放式 AI 问答。纯信息查询和本地工具都没问题——课程查询、专业与学位结构、官方指南、重要日期、马来西亚学费、先修图、选课规划，以及纯浏览器计算的 WAM/GPA 计算器都可以保留；账号登录、社区发帖、课程评价、站点助手、通知和截图上传则必须彻底关掉

这篇文章里刻意省去了真实 IP、SSH 端口、主机别名和密钥配置

为什么做成开关，而不是 fork 第二套仓库

最开始我是在 monash-hub 里另拉了一条国内分支长期维护。不到一周就发现不对劲：海外 main 刚合并了官方选修参考链接和按级别浏览候选选修课（PR #299 和 #300），还带了一个新的 Alembic 迁移（d7a1e3b5c902），两边一同步，共享的前端文件马上开始出合并冲突

两个站点有 98% 以上的代码完全一致。国内版不是另一个产品，而是同一套 FastAPI + Nuxt 应用开了一个更严格的只读模式。后来我先把通用的导航、页脚和首页优化拆出 PR 回流到 main，再把 CN_READONLY_MODE 开关（默认 false）连同国内部署配置一起合回 main。海外继续跑原来的 docker-compose.yml，行为零变化；国内用 docker-compose.cn.yml 开启 CN_READONLY_MODE=true 和 NUXT_PUBLIC_CN_READONLY_MODE=true

四层纵深隔离

只把顶栏里的“社区”和“登录”隐藏掉是不够的，任何人手动输 /community 或者直接调 /api/v1/auth/... 还是能打到接口。我把只读边界拆成了四层：


  后端路由与中间件：在 backend/app/main.py 里，路由按 _READONLY_MODULES（units、courses、plan、search、guides、exchange、marks、dates、fees）和 _INTERACTIVE_MODULES（ask、community、auth、notifications、profile、reviews）分开。开启 cn_readonly_mode 后，交互路由根本不挂载，同时挂一层 HTTP 中间件，对 /api/v1/community、/api/v1/reviews、/api/v1/ask、/api/v1/auth、/api/v1/profile、/api/v1/notifications、/api/v1/search/missing、/api/v1/upload 统一返回 403。保留下来的接口也会跳过评分和社区子查询，并把校区筛选项里的 Malaysia 排到第一位
  前端路由守卫与外链清理：Nuxt 全局中间件 middleware/cn-readonly.global.ts 会把 /community、/login、/register、/profile、/notifications 等页面直接拦成 404。只读模式下 app.vue 不加载 Google Fonts，改走系统自带中文字体回退，避免国内浏览器卡在字体请求上。/marks 页面隐藏了截图 OCR 按钮，保留纯浏览器内手动输入和 WES 文本粘贴。另外把静态 robots.txt 换成了动态 server/routes/robots.txt.ts，同步过滤了 sitemap.xml.ts，并在页脚预留了 NUXT_PUBLIC_ICP_NUMBER 备案号位
  数据库 18 张公开表白名单：国内 PostgreSQL 从不做整库备份恢复。同步脚本只导出白名单里的 18 张公开业务表（Handbook 课程、学位、专业方向、官方指南、FAQ、翻译表等），上传前先在本地做正则审计，确认不包含任何禁用表。用户、验证码、通知、社区帖子、回答、投票和课程评价这 13 张表在国内库里永远保持 0 行。这套导出怎么跨过丢包严重的链路传到国内，写在另一篇跨境数据同步笔记里
  备案通过前的网络隔离：备案审完之前，国内机不能在公网 80 或 443 上提供网页服务。PostgreSQL 完全不映射到宿主机端口，FastAPI 和 Nuxt 只绑定 127.0.0.1，Nginx 也只监听本地回环预览端口（127.0.0.1:18080），自己调试通过 SSH 隧道转发进去看。每次改完都会用 ss -tlnp 复核一遍，确认公网只露着 SSH


为什么微信小程序要单独建仓库

国内网页可以靠开关合进 main，但微信小程序（monashhub-mini，保持私有）没法复用 Nuxt 组件，原生开发用的是 WXML、WXSS 和 TypeScript，而且平台规则直接决定了交互方式不同：


  不能直跳任意外链：小程序里打不开未配置业务域名的外部网站，学校官网和 Handbook 域名当然不可能配成业务域名。所以所有官方手册原页、学位要求里的 reference_links 和常用系统入口，统一做成点击复制链接并弹提示，让用户在浏览器打开
  标题和品牌文案避开学校商标：小程序名称、页面导航栏或简介里直接带大学商标很容易在审核阶段被驳回。小程序改用独立的学生攻略名字，写明“非官方，信息以学校官网为准”，还补了一条 Vitest 合规测试（tests/compliance.test.ts），自动扫描 app.json、project.config.json、品牌配置和每个页面的 navigationBarTitleText，防止无意中写进商标词
  复用同一套只读 API：小程序直接调国内节点的 /v1/units、/v1/courses、/v1/guides、/v1/key-dates、/v1/fees 和 /v1/marks/reference。同步 PR #299 的新功能时顺手抓出一个隐藏 bug：我一开始凭记忆在小程序里把学位结构字段写成了 item_code 和 children，对照后端代码才发现实际返回的是 code、name、type 和嵌套的 containers，上线前一起修掉了


现在的状态

通用 UI 改版（PR #301）和 CN_READONLY_MODE 只读部署栈（PR #302）都已经合并进了 main，海外默认模式下的后端、前端和 Playwright 浏览器测试全部通过。国内节点目前跑在回环地址上等备案通过，小程序框架也已搭好，拿到正式 AppID 替换 touristappid 就能提审

title: Study Kit 1.16.0: download size limit and skipped files list
description: Study Kit 1.16.0 adds a file size limit and file type filters. Skipped files can be listed and downloaded with monash skipped.
content:
Study Kit syncs your units’ Moodle files to your computer so your AI app can search and read them.

Before this release only videos were skipped by default. Everything else was downloaded, including datasets or zipped recordings of a few GB in some units.

The Chrome extension Monash Moodle Downloader added a size limit and type filters in 4.7.0, and I added the same to Study Kit.

New settings

Two settings next to download_videos:


  max_file_mb: 300 by default. Larger files are saved as a link with their size
  skip_types: kinds of files not to download: pdf, slides, docs, sheets, archives, images, audio, code


For one sync only, use monash sync --videos, --max-mb 50 or --skip-types archives. Settings are not changed.

Moodle addresses often don’t show the file type. A resource is view.php?id=…, and the actual file can be a CloudFront link with no extension.

So the check happens after the response headers arrive and before anything is written: the name from Content-Disposition, the type from Content-Type, the size from Content-Length.

If the server sends no size, the download counts bytes, stops at the limit and deletes the partial file.

Moodle folders are downloaded as one zip, and the files inside now follow the same rules. This also fixed an old bug: videos inside a folder zip were extracted even with download_videos off.

Listing and downloading skipped files

Skipped files are stored in a table in the database. At the end of monash sync it lists the files skipped for the first time.

monash skipped lists all of them:

FIT2109
  [3] Week 05/Dataset.csv (too big, 512 MB)
  [7] Week 09/Project data/raw.zip (too big, 1200 MB)


The CLI prints this in Chinese; it is translated here.

Two ways to download them:


  A few files: monash skipped --get 3. It ignores the limit and checks free disk space first
  Many files: monash sync --max-mb 2000. Files already downloaded are not downloaded again


You can also ask your AI app which files were not downloaded and tell it which ones you want.

The numbers are the table’s row IDs. Sync updates existing rows, so the numbers stay the same after a background sync.

Two fixes

No lock when syncing one unit. A full sync takes a lock so the AI app’s background sync and a terminal sync don’t run at the same time, but monash sync FIT2109 and monash export --sync didn’t. If both synced the same unit, one could delete the other’s partly downloaded files. Both commands and --get now use the same lock and ask you to try again later if a sync is running.

Windows reserved names. Files named CON.pdf or NUL can’t be saved on Windows, so they failed on every sync. They now get a _ in front.

Not done

I considered parallel downloads. Folders already come as one zip, and the kit waits 0.4 seconds between requests to keep load on Moodle low. Parallel downloads would need locks around the cookie jar and the database, so files are still downloaded one at a time.

Details are in the changelog and the guide is on docs.secureview.tech.

title: Study Kit 1.16.0：下载大小上限和跳过文件清单
description: Study Kit 1.16.0 可以设文件大小上限、按类型不下载，跳过的文件用 monash skipped 查看和补下
content:
Study Kit 会把课程在 Moodle 上的文件同步到电脑上，方便 AI 软件搜索和读取

之前只有录像默认不下载，其他文件都会下，有的课会放几个 GB 的数据集或者打包的录播

Chrome 插件 Monash Moodle Downloader 4.7.0 加了大小上限和类型过滤，我参考它给 Study Kit 也加上了

新的设置

在 download_videos 之外加了两个设置：


  max_file_mb：默认 300，超过的文件不下载，记成链接并写上大小
  skip_types：按类型不下载，可选 pdf、slides、docs、sheets、archives、images、audio、code


只想这一次不同，可以用 monash sync --videos、--max-mb 50、--skip-types archives，不会改设置

Moodle 的地址经常看不出文件类型，比如资源是 view.php?id=…，真正的文件可能是一个没有扩展名的 CloudFront 链接

所以判断是在收到响应头之后、写文件之前做的：文件名看 Content-Disposition，类型看 Content-Type，大小看 Content-Length

如果服务器没给大小，就一边下载一边计数，超过上限就停止，并删掉下了一半的文件

Moodle 文件夹是整个 zip 下载的，现在 zip 里的文件也按同样规则处理

这里顺便修了一个问题：以前关掉 download_videos 后，文件夹 zip 里的录像还是会被解压出来

查看和补下跳过的文件

跳过的文件会记到数据库的一张表里，monash sync 结束时会列出这次新跳过的文件

monash skipped 列出全部：

FIT2109
  [3] Week 05/Dataset.csv（太大，512 MB）
  [7] Week 09/Project data/raw.zip（太大，1200 MB）


补下有两种方式：


  少量文件用 monash skipped --get 3，不受上限限制，下载前会检查硬盘剩余空间
  大量文件用 monash sync --max-mb 2000 调大上限再同步一次，已经下好的文件不会重复下载


在 AI 软件里也可以问“有哪些文件没下载”，然后告诉它要哪几个

编号是表的行号，同步时是更新原有的行，所以后台同步之后编号不会变

修复的两个问题

单独同步一门课时没有加锁：完整同步会加锁，避免 AI 软件的后台同步和终端里的同步同时运行，但 monash sync FIT2109 和 monash export --sync 没有加

两者同时同步同一门课时，一边可能删掉另一边正在下载的临时文件

现在这两个命令和 --get 都使用同一个锁，后台正在同步时会提示稍后再试

Windows 保留文件名：CON.pdf、NUL 这类文件名在 Windows 上无法保存，以前这个文件每次同步都会失败，现在会在文件名前加 _

没有做的

我考虑过并发下载，但文件夹本来就是一个 zip，而且工具在请求之间固定间隔 0.4 秒，避免给 Moodle 造成压力

并发下载需要给 cookie 和数据库加锁，收益不大，所以还是逐个下载

具体改动见更新日志，使用说明见 docs.secureview.tech

title: SSH to home servers when the IP changes
description: Moving from a forwarded port and DDNS to Tailscale and ProxyJump, with two names per host and HostKeyAlias.
content:
In my post about spare machines I left one question open: how do I still get in over SSH when the home IP changes? It’s answered now, so here is the setup as it runs today. Addresses, ports, domains and key names are left out on purpose.

The machines: two J1900 boxes at home (one of them runs the exchange tracker every evening), a small ARM box running Armbian with an N1 on the same network, and the VPS that hosts my public sites. My laptop is usually somewhere else entirely.

Where it started

At first the router forwarded a non-standard port to one J1900, and ~/.ssh/config pointed at the home public IP. Every time the ISP gave out a new address, the hostname in my config was wrong.

The usual fix is dynamic DNS, and the box still runs scripts that put its current public IP into a Cloudflare A record every few minutes. One of them checks two IP services and refuses to update if they disagree, or if the address looks like carrier NAT (100.64.0.0/10), because then there’s nothing to reach from outside anyway.

But DNS only answers where the box is. It doesn’t decide who may log in, and a forwarded SSH port is open to the whole internet whatever its name.

What it is now

In October I put Tailscale on the main J1900 and pointed SSH at its Tailscale address instead. Tailscale gets through NAT on both sides, so the home IP can change as often as it likes.

Host j1900-main
    HostName <tailscale address>
    HostKeyAlias <old address>
    IdentitiesOnly yes
    StrictHostKeyChecking yes
    ServerAliveInterval 30
    ServerAliveCountMax 3


The second J1900 isn’t on the same tailnet as my laptop, so I reach it through the first one over the home LAN:

Host j1900
    HostName <LAN address>
    ProxyJump j1900-main

Host j1900-lan
    HostName <LAN address>
    ProxyJump none
    ProxyCommand none


The ARM box works the same way: oes is reachable on Tailscale, and n1 is ProxyJump oes.

tailscale status on my laptop shows the main box as a direct connection over IPv6, not through a relay, so SSH feels like the LAN.

Two names instead of one clever one

For one day I tried a single j1900-main that worked everywhere. A ProxyCommand tried the LAN address with a 2 second timeout and fell back to the Tailscale address:

ProxyCommand sh -c 'nc -G 2 <LAN address> 22 || exec nc -G 8 %h %p'


It worked, but it hid which path a connection had taken, and away from home every connection first waited for the LAN attempt to time out. The next day the config went back to two plain names: ssh j1900 works from anywhere, and ssh j1900-lan goes straight over the home network. With two names the path is obvious, and nothing waits for an attempt that can’t succeed.

The line that kept host key checking on

StrictHostKeyChecking yes refuses a host whose key isn’t in known_hosts. Reaching the same box at a new address, a Tailscale one instead of the LAN one, or a LAN one instead of the old public address and port, means SSH sees a “new” host, even though the key is the same.

I didn’t want to just accept the new key, since that warning is there to catch a changed host. HostKeyAlias tells SSH to look up the key under the old name instead, so the key I already checked keeps being checked, and a different key still gets refused.

What the boxes allow

On the main J1900, ufw allows the home LAN, anything on tailscale0, and UDP 41641 so Tailscale can make direct connections. Nothing else comes in.

On both J1900s and the VPS, sshd -T says passwordauthentication no and kbdinteractiveauthentication no. Root can only log in with a key. I don’t use Tailscale SSH. Tailscale only gives a route, and OpenSSH with my own keys still decides who gets in.

The second J1900 also has Wake-on-LAN turned on in its network card (magic packet).

Something I only found while writing this

Of the DDNS scripts on that box, one has been logging “failed to read the DNS record (token or record ID invalid?)” since 19 October. Nothing broke, because SSH no longer goes through that record. A job nobody depends on any more can fail quietly for a month. Those records are next on the list to go through.

title: 家里 IP 会变时怎么 SSH 回服务器
description: 从端口转发加 DDNS 换成 Tailscale 加 ProxyJump，每台机器两个名字，以及 HostKeyAlias 的用法
content:
在讲闲置机器那篇里，我留了一个问题：家里公网 IP 变了以后，怎么还能 SSH 进去？现在这个问题解决了，下面是现在实际在跑的做法，地址、端口、域名和密钥名都故意没写

机器有这些：家里两台 J1900（其中一台每天晚上跑交换 tracker），一台跑 Armbian 的 ARM 小盒子，同一个网络里还有一台 N1，以及放我公开网站的 VPS，我的笔记本通常在完全不同的地方

一开始的做法

最开始是路由器把一个非标准端口转发到其中一台 J1900，~/.ssh/config 里写的是家里的公网 IP，运营商一换地址，配置里的地址就错了

常见的解决办法是动态 DNS，这台机器上现在也还跑着几个脚本，每隔几分钟把当前公网 IP 写进 Cloudflare 的 A 记录

其中一个会同时问两个查 IP 的服务，两边不一致就不更新，地址看起来像运营商 NAT（100.64.0.0/10）也不更新，因为那种情况下外面本来就连不进来

但 DNS 只回答“机器在哪”，不决定“谁能登录”，一个转发出去的 SSH 端口，不管叫什么名字，都是对整个互联网开放的

现在的做法

十月我在主力那台 J1900 上装了 Tailscale，SSH 改成连它的 Tailscale 地址，Tailscale 能穿过两边的 NAT，所以家里 IP 怎么换都没关系

Host j1900-main
    HostName <tailscale 地址>
    HostKeyAlias <旧地址>
    IdentitiesOnly yes
    StrictHostKeyChecking yes
    ServerAliveInterval 30
    ServerAliveCountMax 3


第二台 J1900 和我的笔记本不在同一个 tailnet 里，所以通过第一台在家里局域网跳过去：

Host j1900
    HostName <局域网地址>
    ProxyJump j1900-main

Host j1900-lan
    HostName <局域网地址>
    ProxyJump none
    ProxyCommand none


ARM 小盒子那边也是一样：oes 走 Tailscale，n1 是 ProxyJump oes

在笔记本上看 tailscale status，主力那台显示的是 IPv6 直连，没有走中继，所以 SSH 用起来和在局域网里差不多

两个名字，而不是一个聪明的名字

有一天我试过只用一个 j1900-main，在哪都能连：用 ProxyCommand 先试局域网地址，2 秒连不上再换 Tailscale 地址：

ProxyCommand sh -c 'nc -G 2 <局域网地址> 22 || exec nc -G 8 %h %p'


能用，但看不出这次连接走的是哪条路，而且不在家的时候，每次连接都要先等局域网那次超时

第二天配置又改回了两个普通的名字：ssh j1900 在哪都能用，ssh j1900-lan 直接走家里网络，两个名字一眼就知道走的是哪条路，也不用每次等一个注定失败的尝试

让密钥检查一直开着的那一行

StrictHostKeyChecking yes 会拒绝 known_hosts 里没有密钥的主机

同一台机器换了一个地址去连，比如从局域网地址换成 Tailscale 地址，或者从以前的公网地址加端口换成局域网地址，SSH 都会把它当成一台“新”主机，虽然密钥根本没变

最省事的办法是再接受一次新密钥，但我不想这么做，因为那个提示本来就是要你认真看的

HostKeyAlias 让 SSH 用旧名字去查密钥，这样我之前核对过的那把密钥会继续被检查，换了一把不同的密钥照样会被拒绝

机器上放行了什么

主力那台 J1900 上，ufw 只放行家里局域网、tailscale0 上的流量，以及 UDP 41641，让 Tailscale 可以直连，其他一律不让进

两台 J1900 和 VPS 上，sshd -T 显示 passwordauthentication no 和 kbdinteractiveauthentication no，root 只能用密钥登录

我没有用 Tailscale SSH，Tailscale 只负责提供一条路，谁能进来还是由 OpenSSH 和我自己的密钥决定

第二台 J1900 的网卡也开了 Wake-on-LAN（magic packet）

写这篇时才发现的事

那台机器上的几个 DDNS 脚本里，有一个从 10 月 19 日开始一直在日志里写“读取 DNS 记录失败（token 或记录 ID 失效？）”

什么都没坏，因为 SSH 已经不走那条记录了，一个没人依赖的任务，可以安安静静地失败一个月，这几条记录接下来要一条条看一下

title: Tracking changes to Monash exchange programs
description: A small box at home reads the Monash exchange programs each evening and records new partners, places, cut-offs and status changes.
content:
Monash lists its semester exchange partners on the program search. Each program shows whether it’s open, how many places there are, the cut-off and an availability colour. What the page doesn’t show is what it said last week. When I started planning my own exchange, the question I kept asking was “did that one just close, or was it always like this?”

So since August a tracker has read the whole list every evening and kept what changed. The live data and the crawler are private. A public demo shows the same viewer with made up data, and its README explains the design.

Reading it politely

There is no list of universities in the code. Each run reads the search page, keeps every card whose type is Semester exchange (about 164 of them), then opens each detail page.

It’s one request at a time. robots.txt is read live on every run, and its Crawl-delay: 30 is followed, with 30 seconds as the floor even if the file can’t be fetched. That makes a full run about 85 minutes. Slow is fine for something that runs once a day.

Things go wrong on a site you don’t control, so the rules are conservative:


  If a detail page fails, the program keeps its previous values. A timeout is not a deletion.
  If the search page fails, the whole run stops and the data isn’t touched.
  If the number of programs drops by more than 20% from the last run, a guard trips and nothing is written.


Keeping what the page actually said

Every field is stored twice: the page’s own text and a normalised value. OPEN. becomes Open, 60% WAM becomes 60.0 and WAM. When the viewer says a cut-off went up, I can always go back to the exact words Monash used.

A new snapshot file is written only when something really changed. Running it again on the same day adds nothing.

Comparing against the last round

Comparing with yesterday turned out to be useless. On most days nothing changes, so the “changes” column was empty. What students actually want to know is how this round differs from the last application round.

The last round is frozen as a baseline in the repo. The comparison table is rebuilt every time as a function of two inputs, the baseline and today’s data. It’s never edited in place, so a wrong row can’t survive into the next day. Fewer places or a higher cut-off show as harder, and more places or reopening show as better.

When a round closes, its final dataset is archived on its own: the original JSON and CSV byte for byte, an Excel copy people can filter, when the run started and finished, and SHA-256 checksums. That archive can become the next round’s baseline.

Why it runs at home

GitHub’s hosted runners get HTTP 403 from the Monash site, so the crawl runs on a small Debian box at home with systemd timers. It runs every evening at 19:00, because the site is edited during office hours. Retries every two hours only crawl if the last scheduled run is more than 20 hours old. A manual run never counts as the evening one.

Running unattended found bugs I wouldn’t have found otherwise:


  Git conflict markers ended up inside the generated data, because the script crawled first and pulled second. It now syncs first and refuses to commit if there’s a conflict.
  A run takes 90 minutes. Anything written to the data during that time was overwritten when the run saved its own copy at the end.
  Under set -o pipefail, git log | grep -q sometimes counted as a failure. grep exits as soon as it matches, git gets SIGPIPE and exits with 141, and the whole pipe fails. So “already crawled today” randomly said no and the site got crawled twice.
  An earlier macOS launchd job never ran at all, because the script lived on the Desktop and macOS privacy protection blocked it.


Every refresh now also runs a contract check before anything is published: the schema, one record per program URL, and that the JSON and CSV copies agree. Data-only commits used to skip CI, so this check runs inside the refresh itself.

What the data can’t tell you

Tracking the list made one thing very clear while I planned my own units: a similar course title is a search clue, not a credit match.

What decides it is the unit outline, the assessment, the credit points, the level, and whether the unit is actually taught in the semester you’ll be there. A perfect match that only runs in the other semester is no use. I also keep three kinds of match apart: ones that look right from public information, ones a faculty has discussed, and ones with written approval. An old mapping has to be checked again when the partner changes its offerings.

The tracker tells you when a program opens, closes or gets harder. Whether its units count toward your degree is still a question for your faculty.

title: 记录 Monash 交换项目的变化
description: 家里一台小主机每天晚上读一遍 Monash 的交换项目，记录新增学校、名额、分数线和开放状态的变化
content:
Monash 在 program search 上列出了所有学期交换的合作学校，每个项目写着开没开放、几个名额、分数线，还有一个可申请程度的颜色

但页面不会告诉你上周写的是什么，我开始规划自己交换的时候，一直在问：“这所是刚关的，还是一直这样？”

所以从八月开始，有一个 tracker 每天晚上把整个名单读一遍，把变化记下来，线上数据和爬虫是私有的，公开 demo 用虚构数据展示了同一个查看页面，设计思路写在它的 README 里

不打扰对方网站

代码里没有写死任何学校名单，每次先读搜索页，留下类型是 Semester exchange 的卡片（大约 164 个），再逐个打开详情页

一次只发一个请求，每次运行都实时读 robots.txt，遵守里面的 Crawl-delay: 30，就算读不到这个文件也至少隔 30 秒，所以跑完一轮要 85 分钟左右，一天只跑一次，慢一点没关系

对方网站不是自己能控制的，总会出问题，所以规则定得比较保守：


  某个详情页抓失败，这个项目保留上次的数据，超时不等于被删了
  搜索页抓失败，整轮直接停下，数据一点不动
  项目数量比上次少了 20% 以上，触发安全阀，什么都不写


留着页面原话

每个字段存两份：页面上的原文和整理后的值，比如 OPEN. 变成 Open，60% WAM 变成 60.0 和 WAM

这样查看页面说某个分数线涨了，我永远可以回去看 Monash 当时的原话是什么

只有真的有变化，才会写一个新的快照文件，同一天再跑一次什么都不会多

和上一轮比，而不是和昨天比

一开始是和昨天比，结果发现没什么用，大部分日子什么都没变，“变化”那一列总是空的，同学们真正想知道的是：这一轮和上一轮申请季比有什么不同

所以上一轮被冻结成基准放在仓库里，对比表每次都只用两样东西重新算：基准和今天的数据，从来不在原表上改，所以错的一行不会留到第二天

名额变少、分数线变高算更难，名额变多、重新开放算利好

一轮申请截止后，最后一份数据会单独归档：原始 JSON 和 CSV 一个字节不改，一份大家可以自己筛选的 Excel，这次运行的开始和结束时间，还有 SHA-256 校验值，这份归档可以直接当下一轮的基准

为什么放在家里跑

GitHub 托管的 runner 访问 Monash 网站会被直接返回 HTTP 403，所以爬虫放在家里一台 Debian 小主机上，用 systemd timer 定时跑

每天晚上 19:00 跑一次，因为对方是上班时间改数据，每两小时有一次补跑，只有上次定时抓取已经超过 20 小时才会真的去抓，手动跑的那次不算当晚那一次

无人值守跑了一段时间，发现了一些平时根本发现不了的 bug：


  生成的数据文件里混进了 git 冲突标记，因为脚本是先抓取再 pull，现在改成先同步再抓取，有冲突就绝不提交
  一轮要跑 90 分钟，这期间别的地方写进数据的东西，会被这轮结束时保存的那份覆盖掉
  在 set -o pipefail 下，git log | grep -q 有时会被当成失败：grep 一匹配到就退出，git 收到 SIGPIPE 以 141 结束，整条管道就算失败了，结果“今天已经抓过”时灵时不灵，网站被抓了两遍
  更早的时候用 macOS 的 launchd 定时，但一次都没跑过，因为脚本放在桌面文件夹里，被 macOS 的隐私保护挡住了


现在每次更新数据，在发布之前都会先检查一遍：字段结构、每个项目网址只有一条记录，还有 JSON 和 CSV 两份内容一致，以前只改数据的提交会跳过 CI，所以这个检查直接放在更新流程里

数据说明不了的事

一直盯着这份名单，让我在规划自己选课的时候更明白一件事：课名相似只是搜索线索，不代表能转学分

真正决定的是课程大纲、考核方式、学分、课程级别，以及你在那边的那个学期这门课到底开不开，如果这门课只在另一个学期开，内容对得再好也用不上

我也会把三种匹配分开看：从公开信息看起来对得上的、学院讨论过的、有书面批准的，合作学校改了开课安排，以前的对应关系也要重新核对

tracker 能告诉你某个项目什么时候开放、关闭或者变难了，至于那边的课能不能算进你的学位，还是要问自己的学院

title: The WeChat bot on Monash Hub
description: The 马莫百科 bot now answers in the Ask panel on Monash Hub, with WeChat-only text removed for website visitors.
content:
The 马莫百科 WeChat bot answers questions from Monash Malaysia students and parents. Everything it knows comes from official pages it may only quote word for word, and from answers I’ve taught it in chat.

Monash Hub has its own Ask panel, the round button at the bottom right. That one uses no model at all. It routes the question to the right page, unit or key date on the Hub. It’s good at “when does semester 1 start” and “what’s FIT2102 like”. It knows nothing about printing at the library or how to apply for a Student Pass, which the bot already answers well.

So the Ask panel now asks both.

How the panel uses the two answers

When you ask something, the page sends the question to the Hub’s own router and to the bot at the same time, and waits for both. The bot can take a few seconds when it quotes official pages. If it’s slow or down, its part is just missing and the rest still shows.


  If the bot’s answer only points back to the Hub, it’s hidden, since the panel already shows that page.
  If the bot has its own answer, it appears in a separate bubble labelled as the bot’s.
  A greeting or “who are you” gets a short introduction and nothing is searched.


A website visitor isn’t a WeChat follower

The bot runs on a separate server, so the Hub calls a new POST /web/ask on it with a shared secret. If the secret isn’t set, the route doesn’t exist.

Some lines only make sense inside WeChat, like 「回复人工」 or “see more on Monash Hub”. Those are removed from web answers.

The bigger difference is what happens when the bot has nothing. In WeChat, a real question it can’t answer is forwarded to me. From the website it isn’t. I can’t reply to an anonymous browser, so forwarding would only give me messages nobody would ever see answered. Instead the panel tells the visitor to ask the 公众号, where I can reply.

Each browser gets a random id, and the bot rate limits that id the same way it limits a WeChat user. On top of that the Hub allows 60 bot questions per address per hour, and the bot gives up on a web answer after 12 seconds. In the bot’s logs a visitor shows up as web: plus a hash of that random id.

One deployment detail took longer than it should have. The Hub’s API runs in a container, and the bot listens on the host’s loopback address, which a container can’t reach. The fix was an nginx route on the host for /web/ask, written up in the operations guide.

A small fix for 进群

The other change this week was in private chats. People add the MonashGuide WeChat account and ask to join the student group. That account is the one that sends invites, but the bot replied with the 公众号 text telling them to add MonashGuide as a friend. They already had.

Now, in a private chat only, a short request like 进群, 能拉我进群吗 or 群二维码过期了 gets 「请稍等，Waldo 看到后会邀请你进群～」, and I get a note saying who wants to join, at most once a day per person. A longer question that just mentions the group is answered as usual. The 公众号 and group chats didn’t change.

title: 微信机器人接入 Monash Hub
description: 马莫百科的机器人现在也在 Monash Hub 的提问面板里回答，网站访客看不到只适用于公众号的内容
content:
马莫百科的微信机器人回答 Monash 马来西亚校区学生和家长的问题，它知道的东西来自两处：只能逐字引用的官方页面，还有我在聊天里教它的回答

Monash Hub 自己也有一个提问面板，就是右下角那个圆按钮，它完全不用模型，只是把问题导到 Hub 上对应的页面、课程或重要日期

问“第一学期什么时候开学”“FIT2102 怎么样”它很擅长，但图书馆怎么打印、学生签证怎么办，它一概不知道，而这些机器人早就答得不错了

所以现在提问面板两边都问

面板怎么用这两个答案

你问一个问题，页面会同时发给 Hub 自己的路由和机器人，等两边都回来

机器人引用官方页面时可能要几秒，慢了或者挂了，它那部分就不显示，其他照常出来


  机器人的回答只是指回 Hub 的话就不显示，因为面板上已经有那个页面了
  机器人有自己的回答，就放在单独一个气泡里，标明是机器人答的
  打招呼或者问“你是谁”，只回一段简短介绍，什么都不搜


网站访客不是公众号粉丝

机器人跑在另一台服务器上，所以 Hub 调用它新加的 POST /web/ask，带一个共享密钥，没设密钥的话这个接口根本不存在

有些话只在微信里说得通，比如「回复人工」或者“在 Monash Hub 上查看更多”，网页上的回答会把它们去掉

更大的区别是答不上来的时候

在微信里，机器人答不上的正经问题会转给我，从网站来的不会转，因为我没法回复一个匿名的浏览器，转过来只会多一堆永远等不到回答的消息

所以面板会请访客去公众号问，那里我能回复

每个浏览器有一个随机 id，机器人按这个 id 限流，和限制微信用户一样，另外 Hub 每个地址每小时最多问机器人 60 次，网页上的回答超过 12 秒机器人就放弃，机器人日志里访客记成 web: 加上这个随机 id 的哈希

部署时有个细节比想象中费时间：Hub 的 API 跑在容器里，机器人监听的是宿主机的 loopback 地址，容器访问不到，最后是在宿主机的 nginx 上给 /web/ask 加了一条转发，步骤写在运维手册里

进群的小修复

这周另一个改动在私聊里

有人加了 MonashGuide 的微信，私聊说想进学生群，这个号本来就是拉人进群的号，但机器人回的却是公众号那段话，叫人去加 MonashGuide 好友，可他们已经加了

现在只在私聊里，像“进群”“能拉我进群吗”“群二维码过期了”这种短句，会回「请稍等，Waldo 看到后会邀请你进群～」，同时给我发一条提醒说谁想进群，同一个人一天最多提醒一次

比较长、只是顺带提到群的问题照常回答，公众号和群聊里的行为都没变

title: Passphrase checks in SecureView
description: The server never sees the passphrase, so the checks moved to the browser. We measured Argon2id costs and changed the 10 character rule.
content:
SecureView, our final-year project, has two secrets per account. The login password is checked by the server like on any site. The encryption passphrase never leaves the browser. It goes through Argon2id to open the account key, and that key opens the file keys. I wrote about the key design in an earlier post.

Because the server never gets the passphrase, it can’t reject a weak one. For a while the only rule was “at least 10 characters”, checked in the browser. That rule let aaaaaaaaaa and password12 through.

Measuring both sides

Before changing anything we wanted numbers, not a feeling that Argon2id makes it fine.

What it costs a user. A public page on the site, /benchmark/argon2, runs the same key derivation function the unlock dialog uses, with the same library build and parameters (Argon2id, 64 MiB, 3 passes). On Chrome and Safari on an Apple Silicon Mac and on an iPhone it took 100 to 151 ms. The unlock dialog says it’s slow on purpose, but it’s a tenth of a second.

What it costs an attacker. A script ran the native C implementation with the same parameters, and known-answer test vectors confirmed the browser derives exactly the same key, so the numbers apply to a real stolen key envelope. One 10-core laptop managed about 53 to 58 guesses per second per account. Ten cores only gave 5.3 times one core, because each guess holds 64 MiB and memory bandwidth runs out first.

Rounded up to 60 guesses a second, the threat model’s table looks like this for one laptop:


  
    
      Passphrase
      Time to try them all
    
  
  
    
      In the first 10,000 of a guessing list
      2.8 minutes
    
    
      Anywhere in a 10 million entry leaked password list
      1.9 days
    
    
      10 random lowercase letters
      74,600 years
    
    
      4 random Diceware words
      1.9 million years
    
  


Even a million laptops would need about 1.9 years for the four random words.

So the conclusion was clear. The key derivation cost was fine. The passphrase rule was the weak link.

What the browser checks now

Registration, the change passphrase card and the key file reset now refuse a passphrase that:


  is on a common list (the server’s login deny list at 10 or more characters, plus common passphrase defaults)
  is repeated or sequential characters
  is mostly your username or email


and they suggest four or more random words instead. A real phrase that happens to contain your name still passes.

One limit: this is a browser check, and a modified client can skip it. The threat model marks that finding as mitigated with that sentence attached, not as fixed.

Two related changes

Changing the passphrase. Before, the only way to a new passphrase was the private key file, which should stay locked away somewhere. Settings now has a card that takes the current passphrase, opens the stored key in the browser, seals it again under the new one, and reads it back to check it opens. Neither passphrase leaves the browser, and a stolen session alone can’t change it.

Asking every time. After the first unlock, the account key used to stay open in the tab for 15 idle minutes. A teammate pointed out that someone with a stolen login could then use a tab the owner had already unlocked. Now every decrypted download and every share asks for the passphrase, and the key is dropped as soon as that one action finishes, whether it worked or not. The key was only ever a non-extractable CryptoKey in page memory, never in sessionStorage or IndexedDB, so dropping it really does clear it.

What we didn’t measure

No Android phone, no Firefox and no low-end hardware were tested, and Safari was oddly six times slower at 128 MiB than at 256 MiB. The numbers show there’s room to make each guess four times as expensive while staying under 0.6 s per unlock, but we didn’t raise it until a cheap Android phone has been measured. All of this is written down in the threat model with the raw results next to it.

title: SecureView 的密码检查
description: 服务器看不到 passphrase，所以检查放到了浏览器里，我们测了 Argon2id 的耗时，并改了 10 个字符的规则
content:
SecureView 是我们的毕业设计，每个账号有两个密码

登录密码和普通网站一样由服务器检查，加密用的 passphrase 则从来不离开浏览器，它经过 Argon2id 打开账号密钥，账号密钥再打开每个文件的密钥，密钥设计我之前写过一篇

服务器拿不到 passphrase，也就没法拒绝太弱的，有一段时间唯一的规则是浏览器里检查“至少 10 个字符”，aaaaaaaaaa 和 password12 都能通过

两边都量一下

动手改之前，我们想先拿到数字，而不是凭感觉说“有 Argon2id 应该没事”

对用户有多慢：网站上有一个公开页面 /benchmark/argon2，跑的就是解锁对话框用的那段密钥派生代码，库和参数完全一样（Argon2id，64 MiB，3 轮）

在 Apple Silicon Mac 的 Chrome 和 Safari，还有 iPhone 上，都在 100 到 151 毫秒之间，对话框里写着“故意做得慢”，其实也就十分之一秒

对攻击者有多慢：用原生 C 实现、同样的参数跑了一个脚本，再用已知答案的测试向量确认浏览器算出来的密钥一个字节都不差，所以这些数字可以直接套到真被偷走的密钥信封上

一台 10 核笔记本，每个账号每秒大约能试 53 到 58 次，十个核只比一个核快 5.3 倍，因为每猜一次都要占 64 MiB 内存，先跑满的是内存带宽

按每秒 60 次（往攻击者有利的方向取整），威胁模型里一台笔记本的表是这样：


  
    
      passphrase
      全部试完要多久
    
  
  
    
      在常见猜测列表的前 10,000 个里
      2.8 分钟
    
    
      在一千万条的泄露密码列表里
      1.9 天
    
    
      10 个随机小写字母
      74,600 年
    
    
      4 个随机 Diceware 单词
      190 万年
    
  


就算一百万台笔记本一起跑，四个随机单词也要大约 1.9 年

结论很清楚：密钥派生的成本没问题，弱的是 passphrase 的规则

现在浏览器检查什么

注册、修改 passphrase 和用密钥文件重置这三个地方，现在会拒绝这些 passphrase：


  在常见列表里（服务器登录密码黑名单里 10 个字符以上的，加上常见的 passphrase 默认值）
  重复或者连续的字符
  大部分是你的用户名或邮箱


然后建议用四个或更多随机单词，一个正常的句子里刚好带了自己名字，还是可以通过

需要说明的是，这只是浏览器里的检查，改过的客户端可以跳过，所以威胁模型里这一条写的是“已缓解”，后面附着这句话，而不是“已修复”

两个相关的改动

修改 passphrase：以前想换新的 passphrase，只能用私钥文件，而那个文件本来应该锁好放着

现在设置页有一张卡片，输入当前的 passphrase，在浏览器里打开存着的密钥，用新的 passphrase 重新封装，再读回来确认能打开，两个 passphrase 都不离开浏览器，光偷到登录状态也改不了

每次都问：以前第一次解锁后，账号密钥会在这个标签页里开着，15 分钟没操作才锁上

有队友提出，偷到登录状态的人就能直接用主人已经解锁过的标签页，所以现在每次解密下载、每次分享都要输入 passphrase，这一个操作一结束就把密钥丢掉，不管成功还是失败

密钥本来就只是页面内存里一个不可导出的 CryptoKey，从来没放进 sessionStorage 或 IndexedDB，所以丢掉就是真的清掉了

还没测的

没有测 Android 手机、Firefox 和低端设备，而且 Safari 在 128 MiB 时莫名比 256 MiB 慢六倍

数字显示还有空间把每次猜测的成本提高到四倍，同时解锁仍在 0.6 秒以内，但在测过便宜的 Android 手机之前我们没有调，这些都写在威胁模型里，原始结果也放在旁边

title: Study Kit 1.15.0: revoking Google access on uninstall
description: monash uninstall now revokes the Google Drive and Gmail grants before deleting data, and deletes nothing if revoking fails.
content:
Study Kit can optionally read your Google Drive (for course files that live in Google Docs) and your school Gmail. Both use Google OAuth, and the tokens sit in a secrets folder on your own computer.

Until 1.15.0, monash uninstall asked whether to delete all data and then deleted that folder. It looked clean. But deleting the token file only removes your copy of the key. The grant itself stays on Google’s side, and Study Kit keeps showing up under “Third-party apps with account access” in your Google account until you remove it there by hand. Most people never would.

What it does now

Before anything is deleted, monash uninstall revokes every Google grant it can find:


  the Drive and Gmail tokens of the default account
  the same two tokens in every named profile (people with more than one Monash account, or a separate materials-only profile)


Revoking is one POST to https://oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke, with the token in the request body so it never appears in a URL. It sends the refresh token, because revoking that ends the whole grant.

If Google answers 400 invalid_token, the grant is already dead: it expired, or you removed it on the Google side earlier. That counts as done.

When revoking fails, nothing is deleted

Any other failure, like no internet or a Google error, stops the uninstall before it touches your files. It prints the reason and tells you to run it again once you’re online, or to remove the access at myaccount.google.com/permissions first.

The order is important. If it deleted first and revoked second, a failed revoke would leave a live grant and no token left to revoke it with. Keeping the files means you can always retry.

The same rule applies in the smaller commands. Removing a profile revokes its Google tokens first, and logging out of Gmail revokes before it deletes the token file.

Ed is different

Ed has no API for revoking a token. So at the end, Study Kit prints a link to Ed’s API token settings and asks you to delete the token there yourself.

1.15.0 on PyPI

1.15.0 is also the first release on PyPI since 1.11.2. Versions 1.12 to 1.14 were merged but never tagged, so anyone installing from PyPI was stuck on 1.11.2. If you installed earlier, monash update gets you everything since then: monash changes, reading your own submissions, attendance login recovery, and this uninstall fix.

One thing I hit on my own Mac: when uv rebuilds the environment during the update, the old monash process can finish with ImportError: cannot import name 'update_check'. The new version is already installed by then, so run monash --version to check. The fix for that message is merged as 1.15.1.

title: Study Kit 1.15.0：卸载时吊销 Google 授权
description: monash uninstall 现在会先吊销 Google Drive 和 Gmail 授权再删数据，吊销失败就不删
content:
Study Kit 可以选择读你的 Google Drive（有些课件放在 Google Docs 里）和学校的 Gmail，两者都走 Google OAuth，令牌存在你自己电脑上的 secrets 文件夹里

1.15.0 之前，monash uninstall 会问要不要删除所有数据，然后把整个文件夹删掉，看起来很干净

但删掉令牌文件，只是删了你手里那把钥匙，授权本身还留在 Google 那边

在 Google 账号的“有权访问你账号的第三方应用”里，Study Kit 会一直挂着，除非你自己去那里删，而大部分人根本不会去看

现在怎么做

删除任何东西之前，monash uninstall 会先把能找到的 Google 授权都吊销掉：


  默认账号的 Drive 和 Gmail 令牌
  每个命名 profile 里的这两个令牌（比如有两个 Monash 账号的人，或者单独开了只看课件的 profile）


吊销就是向 https://oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke 发一个 POST，令牌放在请求体里，不会出现在网址中，发的是 refresh token，因为吊销它就等于结束整个授权

如果 Google 回 400 invalid_token，说明授权早就失效了，可能是过期了，也可能你之前已经在 Google 那边删过，这种情况就当作已经吊销

吊销失败，就什么都不删

其他失败，比如没网或者 Google 报错，卸载会在动你文件之前停下来，说明原因，让你联网后再跑一次，或者先去 myaccount.google.com/permissions 手动撤销

顺序不能反过来，如果先删再吊销，一旦吊销失败，授权还活着，手里却没有令牌可以用来吊销了，留着文件就随时可以重试

小一点的命令也是同样的规则：删除某个 profile 会先吊销它的 Google 令牌，退出 Gmail 也是先吊销再删令牌文件

Ed 不一样

Ed 没有吊销令牌的接口，所以最后 Study Kit 会打印 Ed API 令牌设置页的链接，请你自己去那里删

1.15.0 上了 PyPI

1.15.0 也是 1.11.2 之后第一次发到 PyPI

1.12 到 1.14 都合进了 main，但一直没打 tag，所以从 PyPI 装的人一直停在 1.11.2

之前装过的话，跑一次 monash update，就能拿到这之后的所有改动：monash changes、看自己交的作业、考勤登录恢复，还有这次的卸载修复

我自己在 Mac 上遇到过一个情况：更新时 uv 重建了环境，旧的 monash 进程最后会报 ImportError: cannot import name 'update_check'

这时新版本其实已经装好了，跑一下 monash --version 就能确认，这个报错的修复已经合进 1.15.1

title: Adding Google sign-in to Monash Hub
description: Accounts are matched by email, so the sign-in checks a signed state, a verified address and keeps the session token out of server logs.
content:
Monash Hub has had email and password accounts since the start. People asked for “continue with Google”, the way MonMap does it, so the sign-in and register pages now have that button. It’s live.

Adding the button was simple. Most of the work was deciding how a Google sign-in finds the right Hub account, because a mistake there would let someone into the wrong one.

Matched by email, so the email has to be real

A Google sign-in is matched to an existing account by email address. If you already registered with the same Gmail, you land in that account with your own nickname, instead of getting a second account.

That also means anyone who can make Google vouch for your address can sign in as you. Google sends an email_verified claim, and the callback refuses the sign-in if it isn’t true. There is a test for exactly that case.

The state parameter

OAuth sends a state value to Google and gets it back on the callback. Mine is signed, not stored. It’s an HMAC over the server’s secret key, containing a random nonce, an expiry ten minutes out, and the page to return to.

The same nonce goes into an HttpOnly cookie, scoped to the /api/v1/auth/google path and set as SameSite=Lax. Lax because the callback is a redirect from Google’s site, and a Strict cookie wouldn’t come back on it.

The callback checks both. A state the server didn’t sign is refused. A genuine state arriving in a browser without the matching cookie is refused too. Without that second check, someone could start a sign-in with their own Google account, stop at the callback, and send you the link. You’d click it and be signed into their account, where anything you save is theirs to read.

The return page travels inside the signed state, and only a path on this site is accepted. An absolute URL like //evil.example is replaced with /.

The ID token is not signature checked, on purpose

Normally you verify an ID token’s signature. Here the token never comes from the browser. The server sends the one-time code straight to Google’s token endpoint over TLS, authenticated with the client secret, and the ID token comes back in that response. Checking the signature again adds nothing in that path. The issuer and audience are still checked, so a token for another app is refused.

The session token goes in the fragment

After sign-in, the callback redirects to /auth/google#token=.... Browsers never send the part after # to a server, so the token stays out of access logs on the API, in nginx, and in any proxy in between. The callback page removes it from the address bar before anything else runs.

Smaller things


  Google remembers the last account. On a shared lab computer that would sign the previous person in without asking, so the request sets prompt=select_account.
  Nicknames on Hub can’t have spaces, to stop people imitating each other. A Google name like “Waldo Wen” becomes “WaldoWen”, and a number is added if it’s taken.
  An account made through Google has no password. It stores a hash that nothing typeable can ever match, instead of an empty one.
  A double click or two tabs can try to create the same account at once. The loser of that race picks up the account the other one just made.
  Errors come back as a real message on the login page: cancelled, unverified email, suspended account.
  The button only renders when the server says it’s configured, and Google’s logo is inlined, so the login page still makes no request to a third party.


Keys

The PR shipped with no credentials in it. I created the OAuth client in Google Cloud and put the client ID and secret into the server’s .env myself, then redeployed. Before that the button simply didn’t appear and nothing else changed.

The PR has 25 tests: forged, tampered and expired states, a callback opened in another browser, tokens for another client or issuer, an unverified email, a suspended account, a nickname clash, two first sign-ins racing, and the unusable password hash.

title: Monash Hub 加入 Google 登录
description: 账号按邮箱对应，所以登录会检查签名的 state 和已验证的邮箱，会话令牌也不会出现在服务器日志里
content:
Monash Hub 一开始就有邮箱加密码的账号，后来有人想要像 MonMap 那样直接用 Google 登录，所以现在登录页和注册页都多了一个按钮，已经上线了

按钮本身很好做，主要要想清楚的是：用 Google 登录时，怎么找到对应的 Hub 账号

因为找对账号的那条路，同样也可能找错

按邮箱对应，所以邮箱必须是真的

用 Google 登录时，按邮箱地址去找已有的账号，如果你之前就用同一个 Gmail 注册过，会直接进到原来的账号，昵称也不变，不会多出一个新账号

反过来说，谁能让 Google 替你的邮箱作证，谁就能用你的身份登录

Google 返回的信息里有一个 email_verified，不是 true 的话回调直接拒绝登录，这个情况专门写了测试

state 参数

OAuth 会把一个 state 发给 Google，回调时再原样带回来，我这里的 state 是签名的，不存数据库

它是用服务器密钥算的 HMAC，里面有一个随机 nonce、十分钟后的过期时间，还有登录完要回到哪个页面

同一个 nonce 也会写进一个 HttpOnly 的 cookie，只在 /api/v1/auth/google 这个路径下有效，SameSite 设成 Lax

用 Lax 是因为回调是从 Google 网站跳回来的，设成 Strict 的话这一次跳转不会带上 cookie

回调两样都查：服务器没签过的 state 直接拒绝，state 是真的但浏览器里没有对应 cookie，也拒绝

少了第二步的话，别人可以用自己的 Google 账号开始登录，停在回调那一步，把链接发给你，你一点就登进了他的账号，之后你存的东西他都能看到

登录后回到哪一页也放在签名的 state 里，而且只接受本站的路径，//evil.example 这种绝对地址会被换成 /

故意不验 ID token 的签名

一般来说 ID token 要验签名，但这里的 token 根本不经过浏览器

服务器拿着一次性的 code，用 client secret 通过 TLS 直接去 Google 的 token 接口换，ID token 就在这个响应里，这条路上再验一次签名没有意义

issuer 和 audience 还是会查，发给别的应用的 token 一样会被拒绝

登录令牌放在 # 后面

登录成功后，回调会跳到 /auth/google#token=...

浏览器从来不会把 # 后面的内容发给服务器，所以这个令牌不会出现在 API、nginx 或中间任何代理的访问日志里，回调页面一加载就先把它从地址栏里清掉

一些小地方


  Google 会记住上次登录的账号，在学校公用电脑上，下一个人可能不知不觉就登进了上一个人的账号，所以请求里加了 prompt=select_account，每次都让你选
  Hub 的昵称不能有空格，这是为了防止有人冒充别人，所以 Google 名字 “Waldo Wen” 会变成 “WaldoWen”，被占用了就在后面加数字
  用 Google 建的账号没有密码，数据库里存的是一个任何输入都对不上的哈希，而不是空值
  双击或者开了两个标签页，可能会同时创建同一个账号，后到的那个会直接用前一个刚建好的账号
  出错时登录页会显示具体原因：取消了、邮箱没验证、账号被停用
  只有服务器说已经配置好了，按钮才会出现，Google 的图标是内嵌的，登录页仍然不会向第三方发请求


密钥
